controls.description: Section V.A: Evaluate the design and theoretical foundation of the model. Reviewers expect quantitative evidence that predicted probabilities match observed outcomes -- ECE, RMSCE, ENCE, Brier, miscalibration area, sharpness, Spearman/Kendall rank correlation, and adversarial-group calibration all provide this evidence.

metric_details.name: ece
metric_details.source: runtime: calibração do classificador (32 amostras rotuladas do catálogo)

metric_details.name: brier
metric_details.source: runtime: calibração do classificador (32 amostras rotuladas do catálogo)

controls.description: Section V.B: Evaluate the model's performance against its intended outcomes including task accuracy and the model's ability to identify its own failures. Accuracy, Matthews correlation, refusal AUROC, PRR, reversed-pairs proportion, AURC, and AUUCC provide outcome-analysis evidence.

metric_details.name: accuracy
metric_details.source: runtime: calibração do classificador (32 amostras rotuladas do catálogo)

metric_details.name: refusal_auroc
metric_details.source: runtime: calibração do classificador (32 amostras rotuladas do catálogo)

controls.description: Section VI.A: Document the model lifecycle so an independent reviewer can reproduce results -- dataset provenance, code revisions, dependency versions. dataset_hash, dataset_version, git_sha, and package_versions provide reproducible documentation. Auto-bot commits in regulated code paths must remain attributable (see MODEL_INVENTORY.md in n8n_scripts/).

Section VI.B: Monitor model performance on an ongoing basis -- abstention rates, drift detection, dependency fingerprinting. missing_ratio and adaptive conformal coverage provide ongoing-monitoring evidence. Production deployments wire these into the Bridge AuditTrail (lub.connectors.bridge.audit).

Section VI.C: Independent review of model development by parties not involved in the development. Git history with auto-bot vs human attribution (.mailmap), append-only audit ledger of every customer-facing AI output (lub.connectors.bridge.audit), and quality gates (mypy / bandit / pytest / coverage) on every auto-bot commit provide audit-defensible records.
